subject: Quarter turnpoint: OKR triage, scope narrowing & dependency requests
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter turnpoint: OKR triage, scope narrowing & dependency requests

Team —

We’re at the mid-point of the quarter and the signals from telemetry + customer feedback are clear: we need tighter scope for a small set of impact-driving OKRs and concrete dependency commitments for QBR. I attached a lightweight snapshot (okr_snapshot_v2.xlsx) and a short prep doc (qbr_prep_notes.md) with suggested slides. Please review asap.

Top-level asks: 
1) Scope decision (by next Tue, 10/12): which sub-initiatives we pull back from this quarter to protect runway for the latency & dedicated capacity targets. I’ve flagged three low-confidence items in the snapshot.
2) Dependency commitments: infra, product, and partnerships need to commit owners + dates for the critical path items listed on tab 2.
3) QBR bullets: each of you — provide 3 bullets (1 metric, 1 risk, 1 ask) by EOD Thu 10/08 so I can consolidate into the leadership deck.

Initial reasoning: the largest near-term upside is reducing tail latency for streaming and stabilizing our dedicated pool autoscaling. That requires a short engineering focus window + infra ops support for a controlled rollout. If we don’t tighten scope now we’ll miss the latency SLO and the Dedicated commit targets.

Proposed narrowing (high level):
- Pause exploratory quantization experiment on smaller model variants (team: Runtime) — revert to baseline until we have a gated A/B.
- Defer non-critical partner marketplace integration polishing (team: Partnerships) to next cycle.
- Keep on-track: canary rollout for Dedicated (team: Infra + Serving) and prompt-engineering evals (team: Product).

Please reply inline with your commitments and any objections. I’ll set a 30min dependency call Friday 10/09 for alignment.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Product Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter turnpoint: OKR triage, scope narrowing & dependency requests

Mina — thanks for the clear ask and the snapshot. Quick responses: 

- Scope decision: I support pausing the exploratory quantization on the smaller variants for the quarter. The risk profile is higher than expected and the perf delta is marginal for current traffic. Owner: Vanessa (Product Partnerships) — decision locked 10/12.
- Dependencies: Partner marketplace polishing can be deprioritized; I’ll notify the partner PMs (external) and pull the deliverable off the QBR agenda.
- QBR bullets (first pass):
  • Metric: Partner marketplace completion moved from 10/15 -> backlog (low impact on revenue this cycle).
  • Risk: If we delay quantization, cost savings estimate slips ~6% this quarter; acceptable trade for latency stability.
  • Ask: Marketplace partner team to accept a hard deferral and document impact by 10/09.

I’ll update the partner email and copy external contacts; I can own that thread if you want. Agree to the Friday 10/09 30m call — I’ll let Ops know availability.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Partnerships
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter turnpoint: OKR triage, scope narrowing & dependency requests

Thanks — good call on tightening scope. Infra notes / asks: 

- Controlled rollout for Dedicated: Infra can prioritize the autoscaling stability work this sprint but we need explicit freeze windows from Product so we don’t introduce concurrent changes. Proposed freeze: 10/13–10/20 for the rollout validation (owner: Markus).
- Quantization experiment: Runtime team will pause unless Product pushes it back in. I will reassign the infra infra-opt tickets to the backlog.
- Critical infra dependency: we need a YAML change from Core Networking team for the canary routing (ticket NET-4123). Request Naomi’s team to route the change through staging on 10/12 so we can test during the freeze window.

QBR bullets (first pass):
  • Metric: 95th pct latency target for streaming to drop below 420ms by EOW 10/22 (delta target).
  • Risk: NET-4123 delay will push canary validation beyond the quarter.
  • Ask: Naomi — confirm staging change on 10/12 and a point person for rollback scripts.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Infrastructure & Reliability
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter turnpoint: OKR triage, scope narrowing & dependency requests

Markus — I’ve routed NET-4123 for staging on 10/12; owner will be Priya (cc’ed on separate thread). Priya will run the deploy during the 10/13–10/20 validation window and will own rollback.

QBR bullets:
  • Metric: Canary success criteria: 0.3% error-rate increase threshold and <2% cost variance during canary.
  • Risk: If partner de-prioritization cascades to infra (reduced test coverage), the error delta could hide.
  • Ask: Need a two-hour dry-run slot 10/14 for canary routing and rollback rehearsal.

I’ll add the dry-run to Priya’s calendar and confirm the slot by EOD Thursday.

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Core Infrastructure
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, acme-pm@acme.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter turnpoint: OKR triage, scope narrowing & dependency requests

Looping in the product leads and the external ACME PM per Vanessa’s note. Short commitments from Product: 

- Scope: Product agrees to defer the experimental quantization and marketplace polish for this quarter. That frees up two eng sprints to focus on latency/regression testing for Dedicated canary.
- Owners / deliverables:
  • Karthik (Product) — consolidate feature freeze list and publish by 10/12.
  • Priya (Infra) — staging deploy NET-4123 on 10/12, dry-run 10/14 (2hr).
  • Markus (Infra) — validate canary during 10/13–10/20 freeze window and report success metric by 10/22.

External note to ACME: we’ll remove the marketplace polish from this quarter’s scope; ACME PM, please confirm no detection/regression issues on your side for the Dedicated canary.

I’ll collate the QBR bullets into the deck and send a consolidated slide set Friday morning. Thanks all.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager — Serving & Runtime
